name: Kurihara Chizuru
source:
Wife of [url=http://vndb.org/c17594]Takuto[/url].

10 years ago she used to take care of Minato but she had to move away. She sent him a letter but Minato never answered so they lost all contact. Minato is like a younger brother to her.

She recently got married and moved back to her hometown. Her husband is always busy so she is kind of lonely.
She is weak to liquor.
